request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier sent a quote. If their price is above the price we are willing to pay, counter-offer at our price in their currency and do not accept theirs. Ask for every term they did not state (MOQ, lead time, payment terms). Keep what they did state.
request.user:
Our order: 2000 pcs of bluetooth speaker. The most we are willing to pay: USD 5.69 per pcs (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Montevideo. Logo printing: yes. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Northstar Tools Manufacture
Supplier message:
Hi,
Thanks for your inquiry about the bluetooth speaker.
Our best price is USD 7.40 per pcs CFR Qingdao.
If you prefer, we can also offer DDP to your warehouse at USD 8.99 per pcs.
MOQ is 100 pcs.
Lead time 30-35 days.
Payment: 100% T/T in advance.
Please confirm the quantity so we can prepare the PI.
Best regards
What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"quote","quote":{"price":7.4,"currency":"USD","moq":100,"moq_unit":"pcs","lead_time_days":35,"incoterm":"CFR","payment_terms":"100% T/T in advance"}}

text:
{"reply": "Hello,

Thank you for your quotation for the bluetooth speaker.

We are not able to accept USD 7.40 per pcs CFR Qingdao, nor the DDP price of USD 8.99. Our counter-offer is USD 5.69 per pcs, with the order quantity at 2000 pcs, destination Montevideo, logo printing included, and export cartons for packaging.

Please also confirm the following terms so we can evaluate your offer:
- Incoterm and freight arrangement to Montevideo (FOB, CFR or CIF Montevideo)
- Whether the 2000 pcs price includes logo printing and export cartons
- Lead time for the full 2000 pcs order
- Payment terms beyond 100% T/T in advance, such as a deposit with balance against shipping documents
- Minimum order quantity for the logo-printed version

We look forward to your response.

Best regards"}
